title: Activation pulse scrapbook & KPI forecast
overview: Sprint-style KPI canvas for a mid-size feature activation (rolling 3-week runway). Purpose: keep launch owners and oncall aligned, surface early drift, and provide a compact source-of-truth for rapid decisions. This doc is intentionally lightweight: quick metrics, hand-off owners, small remediation playbooks.
kpi_rows: API median latency (p50) | 86 ms | <100 ms | 7d | infra-performance | OK | small tail at 95th on long-context requests
API tail latency (p95) | 420 ms | <300 ms | 7d | infra-performance | WARN | investigate batching config for endpoint /v1/chat
Token cost per 1k responses | $0.72 | <$0.65 | 14d | finance-usage | WARN | consider enabling suggested quantization profile for small replies
Successful responses (%) | 99.6% | >99.9% | 7d | product-ops | WARN | transient model OOMs on heavy requests
New active users (week) | 4.2k | 6k | 7d | growth | OK | cohort concentrated in EU region
Eval regression score (prompt set A) | -0.8 pts | 0 pts | 14d | applied-ml | ALERT | failing hallucination tests on legal prompts

freeform_notes:
Observations and quick hits:
- Small cohort in EU driving much of the early traffic; region routing might need prioritization.
- Consider temporary stricter rate-limits for anonymous endpoints to protect unit economics.
- If eval regression persists after quantization tweak, trigger model fallback chain (see fallback playbook).
Open questions: Who signs final go/no-go? (proposal: Eng PM + SRE lead + Head of Prod Ops).
